content:
ashley: Morning — nightly perf shows ~18% host-side regression, p95 up across gateway path. attaching quick flame link https://perf.redwood.local/trace/6483219876 :grimacing:
raj: Which surface? hosted API or Dedicated?
ashley: ingress -> gateway -> runtime. regression landed after the kernel-selector refactor last night. CPU profile shifted to host parse/tokenize.
tess: I ran the local harness against the new kernel chooser. Top items: tokenize CPU ~+22%, parse/serialize (http2 encode + small writev) spiking, KV cache hit rate stable but lock contended on a hot shard.
michael: Can you paste the flame snippet?
ashley: ```flame snippet (top stacks): host_parse -> tokenize -> http2_encode -> writev -> fd_write```
raj: My hypothesis: batching heuristic now prefers smaller kernels for short sequences which reduces batching/coalescing and increases the number of partial frames -> more writev/syscall overhead.
tess: Reproduced locally by flipping kernel-chooser back to old decision logic. Mean batch size drops ~12% with the new logic.
perf-bot: bench-run 6483219900: baseline p95 host latency 112ms -> 132ms (+18%), cpu-seconds +0.9s/core. full report https://perf.redwood.local/reports/6483219900
michael: Action plan: 1) revert kernel-selector change on canary 2) add ingress coalescing guard to avoid tiny frames 3) add KV lock tracepoint to measure hold times 4) run targeted bench and smoke.
ashley: I'll open the ticket and kick off the canary. created issue #4521 https://tickets.redwood/4521 (summary + initial flame + perf run).
raj: I'll draft the revert PR now. also adding a unit test that forces buffer coalesce and asserts writev count decreases. PR draft -> #4522.
tess: For the KV lock: instrumented probe shows median hold ~30us but tail spiking to 800us under the new codepath for the hot shard. may need shard-split or a try-lock fast path.
michael: If canary passes, we do a staged rollback and then rework kernel selection to prefer slightly larger batching for gateway-traffic. Also evaluate adding a quick prefix/KV prefetch to reduce parse work.
ashley: timeline: canary in next 30m, bench after 1h, report back in this thread. tagging @raj @tess.
raj: started PR, pushing in 5. will ping once CI green.
tess: adding perf test harness case to regression suite so this doesn't slip.
ashley: thanks everyone — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
